school.school_name: 大阪医療秘書福祉&IT専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Find the public confirmation application form for the latest public year on a Sanko disclosure site.
search_queries: 大阪医療秘書福祉&IT専門学校 情報公開
大阪医療秘書福祉&IT専門学校 修学支援 確認申請書
steps: Open the school top page https://www.sanko.ac.jp/osaka-med/.
Prefer the /disclosure/{school-slug}/ page when the site exposes it.
Look for an anchor labeled 2025年度 or a URL ending in docs/yoshiki2025.pdf.
Reject schoolinfo, subject-list, officer-list, and donation PDFs as adjacent disclosure material.
Accept the PDF only after body classification marks it as the target confirmation form and the fiscal year matches the target.

reusable_rules: For Sanko schools, derive candidate disclosure pages from /disclosure/{school-slug}/ and the school /guidelines/ page.
Prioritize anchors containing 20XX年度 when the PDF filename is yoshiki20XX.pdf.
Use the year in the anchor or URL as a strong fiscal-year hint, then verify the PDF body classifies as the target confirmation form.
anti_patterns: schoolinfo.pdf is school information, not the confirmation form.
役員名簿, 授業科目, 実務経験, and 寄付 PDFs are adjacent disclosures and should be pre-filtered.
Do not count FY2025 forms as FY2026 target-year success.

evidence.notes: Windows v136 FY2025 control accepted this PDF for school_id 22.
